name: Mpox
summary: Clade Ib mpox has community transmission in nine European countries; no mpox emergency of international concern in force
state: WHO's situation report of 14 Sep records community transmission of clade Ib outside Africa in nine European countries, including the UK, France, Germany and Italy, with first detections in Chile and Hungary; Africa reported about 200 cases a week (WHO). The emergency of international concern ended in September 2025, though WHO standing recommendations run to August 2027 (UKHSA). Searches to 11 Nov found no newer global count, so clade I spread outside Africa keeps this at Watch.
for_you: Risk to the general public is low. Close or sexual contact is the main route of spread. UKHSA and the NHS publish guidance on symptoms and on mpox vaccination for eligible groups.
rubric_hit: Clade I spreading outside Africa (community clade Ib transmission in 9 European countries) meets Watch; no PHEIC in effect, so not Alert

sources.title: WHO — Multi-country outbreak of mpox, external situation report 69

why: Clade I mpox is more severe and has spread beyond Central Africa.
drivers: Case growth, vaccine access, travel-linked spread.

rubric.alert: PHEIC in effect with accelerating growth.
rubric.watch: Clade I spreading outside Africa or a regional surge.
